name: Chère Pochette
tagline: From forgotten materials to something worth carrying on.

delivery._comment: Working days, shown to search engines (structured data). handlingDays = from payment to the parcel at Swiss Post (info page: within 5 working days). transitDays = Swiss Post to CH/LI.

returns._comment: Return window shown to search engines. Must match the legal texts (src/content/legal) and info.returns.

checkout._comment: Online payment via Zahls (Paylinks per bag). Switched on 30.10.2026 while the site is still behind the preview password, so links and buttons are ready; real payments start once the Zahls account verification (KYC) is approved. Set to false to go back to 'order by e-mail' (the sync then leaves existing links alone).

organisation.programme: YES – Young Enterprise Switzerland, Company Programme 2026/27

seo._comment: Only the content value of the verification <meta> tag; empty = no tag. Not needed when Google Search Console verifies the domain by DNS.
